title: How an image generator is made
instruction: Put the steps in order, from a pile of pictures to a generator you can trust.
steps: Train: the model looks for patterns between pictures and words
Test the model on pictures it didn’t see during training
Watch for mistakes and clichés, and add the data that was missing
debrief: A model learns what is in the data. That is why it is tested on pictures it hasn’t seen, and people watch where it makes mistakes or repeats clichés.
why: Without examples the model has nothing to learn from.
It looks for patterns in the data it was given.
Only new data shows whether it hasn’t just learned by heart.
Out to people only after the test.
Clichés and gaps in the data only show up in use. Fixing them means better data.
